battle.name: 第二次義埃戰爭
battle.theater: 提格雷高原與阿姆巴阿拉吉山區
battle.brief: 一九三五年十月三日，義大利自厄立特里亞與義屬索馬利蘭兩面越境，半年內戰線由提格雷高原推到哈勒與亞的斯亞貝巴。卡面的菲亞特B.R.20轟炸機同年二月首飛、其後量產，東非航空隊在新機服役前靠SM.79與卡普羅尼Ca.111打垮埃軍空軍，B.R.20則接上日後的縱深轟炸任務。

kit.name: 菲亞特B.R.20轟炸機
kit.history: 菲亞特B.R.20是義大利空軍在1930年代中期引進的雙發動機中型轟炸機，隸屬於轟炸航空團，主要負責對敵方縱深目標的轟炸與戰術支援。

countries: 交戰一方是義大利王國：皇家陸軍（Regio Esercito）以「東非義大利帝國」為名分作戰，兵力由本土正規軍、厄立特里亞與義屬索馬利蘭的殖民營（阿斯卡里步兵營、索阿維亞營）、黑衫軍民兵與外籍志願兵組成；最高決策在羅馬由總理墨索里尼主持，東非最高統帥三度更替：德博諾自一九三五年十月起統兵，巴多利奧於同年十一月接任，巴斯蒂科一九三六年三月再行接手。前線分北、中、南三個戰區：北部提格雷由皮爾齊奧·比羅利指揮的「伏爾圖爾諾」軍團與格拉齊亞尼的索馬利蘭集團對峙；中部阿姆巴阿拉吉與阿姆哈拉高原由安東尼奧·納西的縱隊與卡洛·熱洛索的「撒哈拉」遠征部隊作戰；南部奧加登地區則以遠征縱隊配合格拉齊亞尼的集團軍推進。空軍為皇家空軍（Regia Aeronautica）轄下的東非航空兵，約五百架飛機分駐阿斯馬拉、馬薩瓦與摩加迪沙的機場；海軍以紅海分艦隊封鎖港口，並以「和平警察」隨商船登船檢查。另一方是埃塞俄比亞帝國：皇帝的皇家衛隊「加紐」防衛亞的斯亞貝巴，各省軍、「契洛特」常備兵與大批部落徵召兵分列北、中、南三線，由皇帝本人任全軍統帥；空軍是一九二九年成立、由比利時軍事技術代表團協訓的皇家空軍，只有十餘架老式飛機；海軍僅有內湖與紅海的小型艦艇。
countriesEn: Two states fought: the Kingdom of Italy, which fought under the banner of a future Italian East Africa, and the Ethiopian Empire. On the Italian side the Royal Army (Regio Esercito) drew its strength on metropolitan regulars, colonial battalions recruited in Eritrea and Italian Somaliland (Ascari and Savoia units), the Fascist militia and foreign volunteers. Overall direction lay in Rome with Prime Minister Mussolini, and the commander in East Africa changed three times: De Bono from October 1935, Badoglio from November 1935, and Bastico from March 1936. The front was divided into northern, central and southern theatres. In the north the "Volturno" corps under Pietro Pirzio Biroli and Graziani's force in Somaliland faced the northern Ethiopian armies; in the centre Antoine Nasi's columns and Carlo Geloso's "Sahara" expeditionary troops fought around Amba Alagi and the Amhara highlands; in the south expeditionary columns supported Graziani's grouping through the Ogaden. The air arm was the East African aviation of the Royal Air Force (Regia Aeronautica), roughly five hundred aircraft based at Asmara, Massawa and Mogadishu, and the Royal Navy blockaded the ports with a Red Sea squadron while "peace police" boarding parties policed merchant shipping. On the other side stood the Ethiopian Empire: the imperial guard, the Kagnew Band, was to defend Addis Ababa, while provincial armies, the standing "chilot" troops and mass tribal levies were lined up on three fronts under the Emperor as commander in chief. Its air force, founded in 1929 and trained with Belgian advice, numbered no more than a dozen elderly aircraft, and its navy amounted to a few small lake and Red Sea craft.
people: 關鍵人物分屬義方與埃方兩串。義方：總理墨索里尼把這場戰爭當作民族榮譽與帝國擴張的宣傳工程，電令遠東傾國之力投入；德博諾以「征服埃塞俄比亞」為口號發動進軍，卻被梅凱萊方向的反攻與北方山區的僵持拖住，十一月由巴多利奧接替，此人改打速決，集中航空兵、大膽使用化學戰、逐個攻取阿姆巴阿拉吉等要點；格拉齊亞尼在索馬利蘭戰線以持久消耗與游擊應對，一九三六年三月由巴斯蒂科替換。埃方：皇帝海萊·塞拉西親任全軍統帥，下令全國抗戰並在陣地之間往返督戰；北線拉斯·塞尤姆守提格雷卻在梅凱萊被俘；中線拉斯·伊姆魯在阿姆巴阿拉吉堅守約六週，二月十九日因援兵絕望而率部歸降；東線拉斯·德斯塔在達加羅巴受挫，退至梅達戈陣亡；老將貝萊·澤萊克在梅達戈率部衝鋒戰死；蓋貝耶胡在阿德瓦附近陣亡；由比利時軍事技術代表團訓練的加紐衛隊與契洛特常備兵，是全軍唯一現代化的骨幹。空軍方面，義大利飛行員以CR.32雙座戰鬥機與SM.79「海燕」對地掃射立功，地面部隊因此屢次得以推進；埃塞俄比亞皇家空軍的飛行員在少數出動中曾擊傷義方偵察機，但多數飛機在地面被炸毀。
peopleEn: The personalities of both sides carried the campaign. For Italy, Prime Minister Mussolini turned the war into a propaganda vehicle for national prestige and imperial expansion, ordering the East to commit everything it had; De Bono opened the invasion under a slogan of conquering Ethiopia, but was bogged down by the Ethiopian counter-stroke toward Mekelle and by stalemate in the northern highlands, and was replaced in November by Badoglio, who changed the method entirely, concentrating the air force, using chemical weapons boldly and taking strongpoints such as Amba Alagi one at a time. Graziani fought a war of attrition and guerrilla activity on the Somaliland front until Bastico replaced him in March 1936. For Ethiopia, Emperor Haile Selassie was commander in chief, ordered nationwide resistance and travelled between positions to spur the troops; Ras Seyoum held the north in Tigray but was captured at Mekelle; Ras Imru held Amba Alagi for roughly six weeks and surrendered on 19 February 1936 when help could no longer come; Ras Desta was checked at Daga Roba and fell at Medago; the veteran Belay Zeleke died leading a charge at Medago; Gebeyehu was killed near Adwa. The Kagnew guard and the chilot standing troops, trained by the Belgian military mission, were the only modernised formations in the Ethiopian army. In the air, Italian pilots won renown with CR.32 fighters and SM.79 Sparvieros attacking from the air, and it was their work that let the ground troops advance again and again; Ethiopian pilots occasionally damaged Italian reconnaissance aircraft in their few sorties, though most Ethiopian machines were blown up on the ground.
kits: 卡面的菲亞特B.R.20是義大利航空在三十年代中期設計的雙發中型轟炸機：一九三五年二月二十八日首飛，裝兩具伊索塔·弗拉斯基尼Asso系列星形液冷引擎，機首與後部各帶一對Breda-SAFAT 12.7毫米重機槍，正常載彈量約一噸半至一噸八，翼展約二十二米，巡航速度接近每小時四百四十公里，一九三六年正式成軍，編入轟炸航空團，專司夜間與縱深打擊。必須說明的是，一九三五年十月戰爭爆發時B.R.20仍在試飛與量產初期，並沒有參加東非作戰：真正對埃塞俄比亞縱深實施打擊的是SM.79「海燕」雙發轟炸機（每架可掛炸彈或雷射魚雷、裝三挺Breda-SAFAT重機槍）、SM.81「管笛」以及以長程見稱的卡普羅尼Ca.111；B.R.20要到西班牙內戰才首次投入實戰，往後以數百架的產量成為義大利轟炸航空團的骨幹。戰役中真正左右地面局面的，是義方的裝備與補給結構：CR.32雙座戰鬥機與一九三五年底才抵達東非的Macchi C.200負責爭奪制空權並掩護步兵；Carro Armato L3/35輕戰車、菲亞特508C裝甲車與「撒哈拉」卡車隊構成裝甲與機動的骨幹；七十五毫米、一百零五毫米野戰砲與三七式高射砲配發到營一級；步兵主力是第一次世界大戰時期的Carcano M91步槍與舊式機槍。埃塞俄比亞方面只有十餘架Potez 25、DH.60等老式飛機，槍械以栓動步槍為主，沒有戰車，炮兵有限，卻因義方大量供應芥子氣而在裝備表上多出一項別國沒有的項目。
kitsEn: The Fiat B.R.20 on the card is the twin-engined medium bomber designed by the Italian aviation industry in the mid-thirties: it first flew on 28 February 1935, powered by two Isotta Fraschini Asso radial engines, carrying a pair of Breda-SAFAT 12.7 mm heavy machine guns in the nose and another pair aft, with a normal bomb load of roughly one and a half to one and eight tonnes, a span of about twenty-two metres and a cruising speed close to four hundred and forty kilometres per hour. It entered service in 1936, joining the bombardment wings whose task was night and deep penetration raids. It must be said plainly that when the war broke out in October 1935 the B.R.20 was still in flight testing and early production and did not fight in East Africa: the machines that actually struck deep into Ethiopian territory were the Savoia-Marchetti SM.79 Sparviero, able to carry bombs or a torpedo and armed with three Breda-SAFAT guns, the SM.81 Pipistrello and the long-legged Caproni Ca.111. The B.R.20 first saw combat in the Spanish Civil War, and with production running into the hundreds it later became the backbone of the Italian bombardment wings. What really decided the ground battle was the structure of Italian equipment and supply: CR.32 biplane fighters and the Macchi C.200, which only reached East Africa at the end of 1935, fought for air superiority and covered the infantry; Carro Armato L3/35 light tanks, Fiat 508C armoured cars and the "Sahara" truck columns formed the backbone of armour and mobility; 75 mm and 105 mm field guns and 37 mm anti-aircraft pieces were issued down to battalion level; and the infantry fought mainly with Carcano M91 rifles of the First World War and with old machine guns. Ethiopia had only a dozen or so elderly aircraft of the Potez 25 and DH.60 types, armed mainly with bolt-action rifles, no tanks and limited artillery, and yet its inventory carried one item no other army had, because Italy supplied it in quantity: mustard gas.
tactics: 義大利的戰法核心是「以空制地」：先把對方集結的部隊炸散，再讓步兵沿交通線推進。一九三六年一月五日，義方航空兵在德肯德布拉一帶以卡普羅尼Ca.111與SM.79低空掃射，摧毀集結中的埃軍一個師與五十餘架飛機，並切斷摩加迪沙至阿斯馬拉的公路，此役被義方定為整場戰爭的「H時」；自此每次正面突破都由空軍先行，步兵則沿阿斯馬拉、麥萊、德塞至亞的斯亞貝巴的窄軌鐵路與公路推進，補給靠卡車、火車與空投，驢隊把糧彈由後方背到前線。埃塞俄比亞的戰法是「守點加游擊」：以阿姆巴阿拉吉、德加姆哈雷等山間台地為據，居高臨下用機槍與臼砲封鎖隘口，消耗義軍的攻勢；主力避免與義軍在平原作戰，改以師級游擊隊切斷鐵路、伏擊卡車隊、破壞公路與橋樑，讓義軍的補給線始終處在拉鋸之中。雙方空軍都偏低空作戰，埃方飛機多在地面被毀，義方則以CR.32與C.200護住自己的轟炸機，並靠空投與地空聯絡維持戰線；關鍵是要塞一旦失守，埃軍有組織的抵抗就迅速瓦解。
tacticsEn: The core of the Italian method was to master the ground from the air: shatter the enemy's concentrated formations first, then let the infantry advance along the lines of communication. On 5 January 1936 the Italian air force swept the ground at Dekemhare with Caproni Ca.111 and SM.79 machines, destroying an Ethiopian division caught in the open together with more than fifty aircraft, and cutting the Mogadishu-Asmara road; the Italians called that raid the "H hour" of the whole war. From then on the air force opened every frontal assault, the infantry followed the narrow-gauge railway and the road linking Asmara, Mille, Dessie and Addis Ababa, and supply came by truck, by train and by air drop, with mule teams carrying ammunition and food forward from the rear. The Ethiopian method was to hold strongpoints and to harass: from plateau tops such as Amba Alagi and Daga Roba the defenders commanded the passes with machine guns and mortars and wore down Italian attacks, while the bulk of the army avoided set-piece battle on the open plain and instead sent regimental columns to cut the railway, ambush truck convoys and wreck roads and bridges, so that Italian supply lines were permanently in a state of tug of war. Both air forces fought low; Ethiopian aircraft were usually destroyed on the ground, and the Italians kept their bombers covered by CR.32 and C.200 fighters and held the line with air drops and ground-to-air liaison. The decisive point was that once a strongpoint fell, organised Ethiopian resistance collapsed with it.
data: 數字只能給出量級而非精確值。義大利一方，開戰時在厄立特里亞與義屬索馬利蘭投入約十七萬人，戰役高峰時在東非的兵力增至五十萬至六十萬人，其中殖民營與民兵佔相當比重；東非作戰飛機由開戰初期的約五百架增至六百架以上，戰役中損失數十架；裝甲方面只有數十輛L3/35輕戰車，數百輛裝甲車與數千輛卡車才是真正的機動力量。埃塞俄比亞一方，可徵召兵力從五十萬到一百萬不等，絕大部分是持栓動步槍的部落兵與省級民兵；空軍只有十三至十五架飛機，開戰後數日內大部分在地面被毀，軍械以Carcano M91與更舊的步槍為主。化學武器的用量是本役最刺眼的數字：義方在五個月內施放芥子氣總量以數百噸計，常被引述為約三百噸，毒氣彈以萬發計，並集中使用於德加姆哈雷、阿姆巴阿拉吉與梅達戈幾個方向。傷亡數字各方統計分歧極大，義方陣亡約一萬五千至兩萬人，埃方陣亡從數萬到逾十萬都有估計；而乾旱、饑荒與疾病造成的非戰鬥減員，比戰鬥傷亡更難核實，也更難補回。
dataEn: Figures can only be given as orders of magnitude, not as precise counts. On the Italian side roughly one hundred and seventy thousand men were committed at the outset in Eritrea and Italian Somaliland, and the force in East Africa grew to between five hundred and six hundred thousand at the height of the campaign, with colonial battalions and militia making up a considerable share; the aircraft available for operations in East Africa rose from about five hundred at the start to over six hundred, with several dozen lost during the fighting; in armour there were only a few dozen L3/35 light tanks, and it was several hundred armoured cars and several thousand trucks that formed the real mobile force. On the Ethiopian side the men that could be raised numbered between five hundred thousand and one million, the great majority of them tribal levies and provincial militia armed with bolt-action rifles; the air force possessed only thirteen to fifteen aircraft, most of which were destroyed on the ground within days of the opening of the war, and the infantry was armed mainly with Carcano M91 rifles and older weapons still. The quantity of chemical weapons is the most glaring figure of the campaign: Italy released mustard gas amounting to several hundred tonnes over five months, commonly cited at about three hundred tonnes, in shells counted by the ten thousand, concentrated on the Daga Roba, Amba Alagi and Medago directions. Casualty figures differ wildly between sources: Italian dead are put at roughly fifteen to twenty thousand, while Ethiopian losses are estimated anywhere from several tens of thousands to over a hundred thousand, and the non-battle attrition caused by drought, famine and disease was harder to count and far harder to replace than the losses of battle.
cause: 打起來的原因有遠因也有近因。遠因是義大利在東非的殖民擴張與經濟算盤：一九二八年義埃友好條約之後，義大利在埃塞俄比亞的實業投資佔當地外資的大頭，卻拿不到足夠的礦產與土地，亟需一個能養活數十萬殖民軍、又能給墨索里尼宣傳用的帝國。近因是一九三四年十二月沃瓦沃的邊境衝突：義方哨所遇襲，雙方各有死傷，義大利據此指責埃塞俄比亞侵略，並把事件提交國際聯盟；聯盟一九三五年七月雖認定義方為侵略者，卻既不制裁也不停火，義大利由此判定聯盟無力阻止自己，決心用一場戰爭撕毀條約與默契。一九三五年十月三日，義方在兩個方向同時越境，用「制裁」與「秩序整頓」的名義把侵略包裝成合法行動；同一時期義大利還在歐洲與英國就紅海航行權、商船「和平警察」與港口封鎖互相恫嚇，令整件事看來像一場歐洲外交的插曲，而聯盟內部的分歧又使它無法迅速處理。埃塞俄比亞全國因此被拖入一場本可避免的戰爭。
causeEn: The war had both a remote cause and an immediate one. The remote cause was Italian colonial expansion and the arithmetic of investment in East Africa: after the 1928 Treaty of Friendship, Italian business held the greater share of foreign capital in Ethiopia, yet the country yielded neither sufficient minerals nor sufficient land, and the government needed an empire able to feed hundreds of thousands of colonial troops and to serve Mussolini's propaganda. The immediate cause was the clash at Walwal in December 1934, when an Italian outpost was attacked, casualties were inflicted on both sides, and Italy denounced Ethiopia as the aggressor and took the case to the League of Nations. In July 1935 the League judged Italy the aggressor, yet imposed neither sanctions nor a ceasefire, and Italy concluded that the League was unwilling to restrain it and settled on war to tear up the treaty and the understandings behind it. On 3 October 1935 Italian forces crossed the border in two directions, packaging aggression as "sanctions" and as a restoration of order; at the same time Italy and Britain were threatening each other over Red Sea navigation rights, the boarding of merchant ships by "peace police" and the blockade of ports, so that the whole affair looked like a European diplomatic sideshow while divisions inside the League prevented any quick handling of it. Ethiopia was thereby dragged into a war that could have been avoided.
impact: 後果不止於非洲。國際聯盟在事後被迫追認義方為侵略者，行動上卻一無所成，歐洲集體安全的信號就此破滅；英國在戰爭初期只推行武器禁運而始終不敢提石油禁運，美國保持孤立，四年後歐洲開戰時，已經沒有人相信聯盟的條約能擋住侵略者。義大利則因這場速勝而聲勢大漲，一九三六年秋與德國結成軸心，隨即以志願兵與航空兵插手西班牙內戰，把在埃塞俄比亞得心應手的空軍運用與化學戰經驗帶回歐洲戰場，此後軸心國在中國戰場使用化學武器的作風，可由此找到最早的源頭。埃塞俄比亞本身付出慘重代價：北部與中部被義方以鐵路、據點與空軍嚴密控制，據點式統治難以深入鄉村，大批守軍在撤退與游擊中損失，國家元氣大傷；流亡英國的皇帝在倫敦呼籲國際干預，反而成為世界反法西斯宣傳中最具象徵性的形象之一。戰爭留下的另一項長期後果在裝備與戰術層面：義方把在非洲用得順手的卡車、摩托化、制空權優先打擊與化學戰一路帶回歐洲，非洲戰場被義方內政宣傳為帝國復興的起點。
impactEn: The consequences reached far beyond Africa. The League of Nations was forced after the event to recognise Italy as the aggressor but achieved nothing in action, and the credibility of European collective security collapsed; Britain at the beginning of the war applied only an arms embargo and never dared propose an oil embargo, the United States stayed isolationist, and by the time war came to Europe four years later nobody believed any more that a League treaty could stop an aggressor. Italy, lifted by the speed of its victory, closed ranks with Germany in the autumn of 1936 and then intervened in the Spanish Civil War with volunteers and squadrons, carrying the air power and chemical warfare lessons so usefully applied in Ethiopia back into the European theatre; the Axis use of chemical weapons in China can be traced back to that same source. Ethiopia itself paid a heavy price: the north and centre were sealed under tight Italian control by railway, strongpoint and air power, a strongpoint system that could not reach into the countryside, and large numbers of defenders were lost in retreat and in guerrilla fighting, leaving the country drained. The Emperor, exiled in Britain, called for international intervention from London and became, unintentionally, one of the most symbolic images of world anti-fascist propaganda. A further long-term consequence lay at the level of equipment and doctrine: Italy took back to Europe the trucks, motorisation, priority given to air power and chemical warfare that had worked so well in Africa, and the African battlefield was used at home as the starting point of a revival of the empire.
result: 結果是義大利完勝，代價卻並不小。一九三六年五月五日亞的斯亞貝巴陷落，有組織抵抗全面崩潰；五月九日維克多·艾曼努埃萊三世自稱「埃塞俄比亞皇帝」，五月十九日正式吞併埃塞俄比亞，與厄立特里亞、義屬索馬利蘭合組「東非義大利帝國」；海萊·塞拉西於五月四日離京，八月十三日抵達吉布提，隨後流亡英國。北方山區的零星抵抗延續到一九三七年之後，聯盟的軍事委員會到一九三六年三月才抵達亞的斯亞貝巴，介入為時已晚，戰局無從改變。義方以遠低於預期的代價取得高原，卻背上一個難以治理的帝國，財政與人力被長期吞噬，四年後在北非與東非的戰線上幾乎全部崩解。殘存的埃軍單位、營建器材與山地作戰經驗在南方游擊中延續，皇帝更於一九四一年隨英軍回到亞的斯亞貝巴復辟；東非的版圖與戰爭樣式，自此被第二次世界大戰重新改寫。
resultEn: The outcome was a complete Italian victory, though at no small cost. On 5 May 1936 Addis Ababa fell and organised resistance collapsed; on 9 May Victor Emmanuel III proclaimed himself Emperor of Ethiopia, and on 19 May Italy formally annexed the country, joining Eritrea and Italian Somaliland into the Italian East Africa empire. Haile Selassie left the capital on 4 May, reached Djibouti on 13 August and went into exile in Britain. Scattered resistance in the northern highlands continued past 1937, and the military committee of the League only reached Addis Ababa in March 1936, far too late to change the course of the campaign, which had already been decided. Italy took the highlands at a cost far below what had been expected, but inherited an empire that was hard to govern and that drained the treasury and the manpower of the country until almost all of it collapsed on the North African and East African fronts four years later. Surviving Ethiopian units, engineering stores and experience of mountain fighting carried on in the southern guerrillas, and the Emperor returned to Addis Ababa with the British in 1941; the map and the style of war in East Africa were henceforth rewritten by the Second World War.
